description: This file defines the ReviewerRating entity class for the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes properties such as rating, comment, references to associated reviewer, performance review, and KPI entities, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ReviewerRating
classes.description: An entity class representing a reviewer’s rating of a performance review, including rating value, comments, and associations to reviewer, review, and KPI entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reviewer rating.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the reviewer rating.

methods.name: getRating
methods.description: Retrieves the rating value assigned by the reviewer.

methods.name: setRating
methods.description: Sets the rating value assigned by the reviewer.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves the comment provided by the reviewer.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment provided by the reviewer.

methods.name: getPerformanceReview
methods.description: Gets the associated performance review entity.

methods.name: setPerformanceReview
methods.description: Associates this rating with a specific performance review.

methods.name: getReviewer
methods.description: Returns the reviewer who provided this rating.

methods.name: setReviewer
methods.description: Sets the reviewer for this rating.

methods.name: getKpi
methods.description: Returns the KPI related to this rating, if any.

methods.name: setKpi
methods.description: Associates a KPI with this rating.
